summary: In November 2158 at Sol, Riker receives confirmation that the Spits will receive the third colony ship but remains concerned that their refuge will not last until departure. At a United Nations meeting, Colonel Butterworth describes escalating threats from VEHEMENT. Minister Cranston then introduces Riker to Julia Hendricks, a descendant of Riker's sister Andrea, and Riker and Julia spend several hours talking.

introducing.name: VEHEMENT
introducing.description: VEHEMENT is an anonymous movement that advocates human extinction. It threatens violence and guerrilla tactics to coerce people into ending reproduction, with reported incidents appearing opportunistic and geographically dispersed.
introducing.current_state: Colonel Butterworth reports that its rhetoric has become more intense since Riker appeared.

updates.current_state: The group is to receive the third colony ship, but Riker expects Spitsbergen will not remain viable until its people can leave.
